::: {.hero}
# We're building the perception platform for developers.
:::

::: {.ethos-section}

::: {.ethos-content}
Perception capabilities are often complex and brittle; our platform helps make them plug-and-play. Our SDKs fuse LiDAR, IMU, GNSS, and camera data alongside GPU-accelerated processing, calibration, and analytics. We focus on developer experience as much as core capability so that developers can deliver perception without reinventing the stack. 

Spun out of MIT and Stripe, we bring together cutting-edge research with a deep understanding of developer-first platforms. Our aim is not just to push perception metrics, but to translate them into product features that help developers solve real-world problems—making perception an accessible and dependable layer for every application.

We specialize in robust perception for the unstructured environments that typically break SLAM. Our work includes developing visual features that hold up under scale, rotation, and affine variations; incorporating optical flow to improve tracking in low-texture scenes and avoid treating moving objects as landmarks; and building semantic maps that distinguish between static and dynamic elements. We are also extending ground models to work seamlessly with LiDAR, strengthening shadow detection and terrain understanding.
